title: A group of fossil bones
hook: Several fossils can occur in the same place.

knows: Fossils can be found in sedimentary deposits.
doesNotKnow: Distinguish a fossil cluster from a proven social group.

misconception: Fossils in one place automatically prove a living social group.
objective: Distinguish a fossil cluster from a proven social group.

claims.text: Several fossils can occur in the same place. Several dinosaur skeletons occur together in one deposit. What can be said without additional evidence? The schematic shows several skeletons in one deposit. Their co-occurrence is evidence about where remains were found; additional geological and biological evidence is needed to infer social behavior or the exact timing of death.
